authors: C. Marboe, V. Velizhanin, D. Volin
title: Six-loop anomalous dimension of twist-two operators in planar N=4 SYM theory
journal: not listed on the arXiv abstract page
claim: General-spin six-loop twist-two anomalous dimension: ABA part derived, wrapping terms reconstructed from QSC values at the first 35 even spins; satisfies BFKL, generalized double-log and small-spin constraints.
scheme: No regularization: not a DR (or any Feynman-graph) computation. Planar spectrum obtained from the integrable AdS5 x S5 worldsheet S-matrix (asymptotic Bethe ansatz with BES/BHL dressing phase) plus finite-size corrections. QSC values at fixed spin + reconstruction of a general-spin formula in a harmonic-sum basis.

assumed: all-loop integrability of planar N=4 SYM / AdS5 x S5 superstring
asymptotic Bethe ansatz with the BES/BHL dressing phase (exact worldsheet S-matrix)
identification of gauge-theory anomalous dimensions with string energies (AdS/CFT) in the planar limit
harmonic-sum basis ansatz for the general-spin formula
